scope: NRL as a whole: competition, football, positions, team-list terminology, player status, injuries, match/rules language, statistics and betting-market terminology used in NRL research. MAYHEM/site architecture terms are excluded and belong in the Site Master Glossary.
rules: Preserve the NRL term as encountered.
Expand abbreviations only when supported by an authoritative source.
Do not guess unresolved football, statistical, injury, rules or market terminology.
Flag context-dependent NRL terms as AMBIGUOUS.
Every verified NRL term may become a research target through synonyms, related statistics, roles, rules or source terminology.
A glossary entry is a research lead, not evidence of a football proposition by itself.
Do not place MAYHEM architecture, audit-state or site-operation terminology in this glossary.

categories.AMBIGUOUS: Context-dependent NRL terminology requiring disambiguation before research use.
categories.COMPETITION: NRL competition structure and competition-level terminology.
categories.INJURY / MEDICAL: Injury, availability and match-day medical terminology encountered in NRL reporting.
categories.MARKET: Betting-market terminology relevant to NRL research.
categories.PLAYER STATUS: Player availability, experience and selection-status terminology.

terms.plain_language: The reduced squad published around 24 hours before kickoff under the NRL team-list process.
terms.research_use: Compare the reduced squad with the original team list and later final team for withdrawals, promotions and positional changes.

terms.plain_language: A recorded match appearance for a player in the specified competition or season.
terms.research_use: Establish sample size, experience and season participation before interpreting other statistics.

terms.plain_language: Average number of ball carries or hit-ups recorded per match in the relevant statistical source.
terms.research_use: Compare forward workload, role change and replacement-player usage.

terms.plain_language: Average metres gained from a player's kicks in the relevant statistical source.
terms.research_use: Assess field-position responsibility and changes in kicking role.

terms.plain_language: Average metres a player runs with the ball per match in the relevant statistical source.
terms.research_use: Compare workload, position-specific production and role continuity.

terms.plain_language: A player formally named as team captain for the relevant match or squad.
terms.research_use: Track leadership selection, captaincy changes and whether a returning or absent captain changes the named side.

terms.plain_language: A backline position generally named inside the winger in an NRL team list.
terms.research_use: Target centre-specific availability, defensive combination, running and attacking-production evidence.

terms.plain_language: Ladder points awarded under the competition rules for match outcomes and any applicable competition provisions.
terms.research_use: Compare ladder position, finals implications and late-season incentives without substituting points differential for competition points.

terms.plain_language: A player's first appearance at the specified competition level, such as an NRL Premiership debut.
terms.research_use: Identify genuinely first-game players and separate NRL debut status from lower-grade experience.

terms.plain_language: A player retained in the extended squad outside the primary match-day interchange at that publication stage.
terms.research_use: Track possible late promotion without treating the player as confirmed in the final 17.

terms.plain_language: Average fantasy-game points recorded for a player by the relevant source.
terms.research_use: Use only as a secondary workload or production signal and compare it with component statistics.

terms.plain_language: The cumulative fantasy-game points credited to a player by the relevant source and scoring system.
terms.research_use: Use as a secondary composite indicator and inspect the underlying component statistics before drawing football conclusions.

terms.plain_language: The match-day team confirmed closest to kickoff after the staged team-list reductions and late changes.
terms.research_use: Establish the actual named side immediately before kickoff and compare it with earlier squads.

terms.plain_language: One of the two primary halves positions in an NRL team list, commonly jersey number 6.
terms.research_use: Target playmaking, kicking, try-assist, line-break-assist and combination evidence.

terms.plain_language: A kick or play credited with forcing the defending side into a goal-line drop-out under the applicable rules or statistical definition.
terms.research_use: Assess repeat-set creation and kicking pressure for relevant playmakers.

terms.plain_language: The completed-match state after play has ended and a final result is available.
terms.research_use: Trigger result, scoring and post-match evidence research.

terms.plain_language: A backline position commonly listed at jersey number 1 in an NRL team list.
terms.research_use: Target running, support play, kick-return, try, line-break and positional-continuity evidence.

terms.plain_language: A successful kick at goal credited to a player in the relevant match or statistical record.
terms.research_use: Research goal-kicking responsibility, scoring contribution and changes in designated kicker.

terms.plain_language: One of the two primary halves positions in an NRL team list, commonly jersey number 7.
terms.research_use: Target kicking responsibility, field position, try creation, repeat-set generation and halves-combination evidence.

terms.plain_language: An injury involving the hamstring muscle group, as reported by an authoritative team or league source.
terms.research_use: Track availability, return timing and any documented workload or positional consequence without inferring severity beyond the source.

terms.plain_language: The match-day assessment process used after a player is removed for a suspected head injury under the applicable NRL protocols.
terms.research_use: Distinguish a temporary assessment from a confirmed diagnosis and track whether the player returned or was ruled out.

terms.plain_language: Common abbreviation for Head Injury Assessment in NRL match reporting.
terms.research_use: Search both the abbreviation and full term when researching match-day head-injury events.

terms.plain_language: A bookmaker market pricing each team simply to win the match.
terms.research_use: Acquire two-sided prices for implied-probability and market-movement research.

terms.plain_language: A recorded ball carry commonly used in forward-workload statistics under the relevant source definition.
terms.research_use: Research carry volume, forward workload and role changes alongside running and post-contact metres.

terms.plain_language: The central dummy-half position commonly listed at jersey number 9 in an NRL team list.
terms.research_use: Target distribution volume, tackles, ruck involvement, running and replacement-hooker evidence.

terms.plain_language: The probability corresponding to quoted betting odds before or after any stated adjustment for bookmaker margin.
terms.research_use: Convert prices into a probability baseline and distinguish raw implied probability from normalized probability.

terms.plain_language: A player named on the match-day bench who can enter the game as part of the team's interchange rotation.
terms.research_use: Research bench composition, role coverage, rotation changes and replacement effects.

terms.plain_language: The squad number shown beside a player in a published team list, usually corresponding to the named position or bench slot at that stage.
terms.research_use: Track positional changes and promotions while avoiding the assumption that a jersey number alone proves final match role.

terms.plain_language: Metres attributed to a player's kicks under the relevant statistical source definition.
terms.research_use: Assess field-position responsibility, long-kicking workload and changes in primary kicker.

terms.plain_language: A change to the named side close to kickoff after earlier team lists have been published.
terms.research_use: Search final-team and late-mail sources for withdrawals, promotions and positional reshuffles.

terms.plain_language: Near-match team news or official selection updates published after the initial team list.
terms.research_use: Search for withdrawals, positional changes, reduced squads and late availability information.

terms.plain_language: In betting context, the points handicap applied to a team; in football context, it can also refer to an attacking or defensive line.
terms.research_use: Disambiguate context before using the term in market or football analysis.

terms.plain_language: A recorded break through the defensive line under the source's statistical definition.
terms.research_use: Assess attacking penetration, especially for backs and edge players.

terms.plain_language: A recorded action credited with creating a teammate's line break.
terms.research_use: Assess playmaking and chance creation beyond tries and try assists.

terms.plain_language: A forward position commonly listed at jersey number 13 in an NRL team list.
terms.research_use: Target middle workload, passing involvement, tackles, running metres and role evidence.

terms.plain_language: A dataset or player record with relatively few observations, limiting confidence in broad conclusions.
terms.research_use: Trigger broader career, reserve-grade and role-context research while preserving uncertainty.

terms.plain_language: A defensive tackle attempt recorded as missed under the relevant statistical source definition.
terms.research_use: Research defensive efficiency and role-specific defensive burden alongside tackles made and minutes played.

terms.plain_language: The recorded number of minutes a player participated in a match.
terms.research_use: Normalize workload and production comparisons and identify major changes in rotation or role.

terms.plain_language: An implied win probability after removing the bookmaker margin from both sides of a two-team market.
terms.research_use: Create a cleaner market baseline for comparing prices across time or sources.

terms.plain_language: The top-level National Rugby League premiership competition referred to in official NRL player and team records.
terms.research_use: Keep NRL Premiership statistics separate from reserve-grade, junior, trial and other competition records.

terms.plain_language: A New South Wales senior reserve-grade rugby league competition appearing in club and player-development records.
terms.research_use: Research lower-grade form and experience while keeping it explicitly separate from NRL Premiership production.

terms.plain_language: The bookmaker price offered on a betting outcome.
terms.research_use: Track market movement, convert to implied probability and compare prices across capture times.

terms.plain_language: A pass released by a ball-carrier while engaged by the defence, as credited under the relevant statistical definition.
terms.research_use: Assess second-phase creation, ball-playing tendency and changes in forward or edge role.

terms.plain_language: The amount by which bookmaker implied probabilities sum to more than 100 percent.
terms.research_use: Estimate bookmaker margin and normalize two-way prices.

terms.plain_language: An injury involving the pectoral region or muscle, as reported by an authoritative team or league source.
terms.research_use: Track availability and return-to-play reporting without inferring severity, surgery or recovery stage beyond sourced information.

terms.plain_language: Points scored minus points conceded across the specified set of matches.
terms.research_use: Compare season strength and recent scoring balance without relying only on win-loss record.

terms.plain_language: Total points conceded by a team across the specified set of matches.
terms.research_use: Research defensive output and scoring trends alongside opponent strength and venue context.

terms.plain_language: Total points scored by a team across the specified set of matches.
terms.research_use: Research attacking output and scoring trends alongside opponent strength and venue context.

terms.plain_language: Metres gained after first defensive contact under the relevant source's statistical definition.
terms.research_use: Assess carry effectiveness and middle-forward contribution.

terms.plain_language: The period after a fixture has been completed.
terms.research_use: Research verified result, player output, tactical outcomes and injuries or incidents that occurred during the match.

terms.plain_language: A player named in a current squad who has not yet produced a completed NRL Premiership statistical sample.
terms.research_use: Search official lower-grade, junior, trial and team-list evidence without representing it as NRL production.

terms.plain_language: A middle-forward position commonly listed at jerseys 8 and 10 in an NRL team list.
terms.research_use: Target hit-ups, running metres, post-contact metres, tackles, minutes and rotation evidence.

terms.plain_language: Recorded occasions a player receives possession under the source's statistical definition.
terms.research_use: Assess distribution involvement and role volume, especially for spine players.

terms.plain_language: In team-list context, a player retained outside the primary match-day 17 or in an extended squad; exact status depends on the published team-list stage.
terms.research_use: Research the specific team-list stage before assuming the player is selected to play.

terms.plain_language: A numbered stage of the regular-season competition schedule containing that round's fixtures.
terms.research_use: Anchor player and team performance to the correct chronological fixture context.

terms.plain_language: Metres gained by a player while carrying the ball under the relevant statistical source definition.
terms.research_use: Assess workload and ball-carrying production by role, match and season.

terms.plain_language: An edge-forward position commonly listed at jerseys 11 and 12 in an NRL team list.
terms.research_use: Target edge workload, defensive involvement, running, offloads and combination evidence.

terms.plain_language: A temporary dismissal from the field imposed under the applicable NRL rules.
terms.research_use: Identify match periods played with unequal numbers and keep the event separate from pre-match player-quality analysis.

terms.plain_language: The players named to begin the match in the starting 13.
terms.research_use: Compare initial team lists with later changes and final match-day selections.

terms.plain_language: A defensive action credited as a completed tackle under the relevant statistical source definition.
terms.research_use: Assess defensive workload and compare it with minutes, missed tackles and positional role.

terms.plain_language: A recorded occasion where the ball-carrier breaks or escapes a tackle under the source's statistical definition.
terms.research_use: Assess running threat and contact effectiveness.

terms.plain_language: A defensive efficiency percentage derived or published from tackle and missed-tackle data under the relevant source methodology.
terms.research_use: Compare defensive effectiveness only after confirming the source formula and sample size.

terms.plain_language: The officially published squad and positional listing for a fixture at a specified stage before kickoff.
terms.research_use: Establish who was named, in what role, and how the side changed through later squad reductions.

terms.plain_language: In betting context, the bookmaker's combined-points line; elsewhere it may refer to a cumulative statistical total.
terms.research_use: Disambiguate before using it in market or statistical research.

terms.plain_language: Cumulative running metres credited to a player across the specified matches or season.
terms.research_use: Compare total workload with appearances and average running metres.

terms.plain_language: A try credited to a player in the relevant competition and statistical record.
terms.research_use: Research finishing output while separating try totals from chance creation, role and opportunity volume.

terms.plain_language: A recorded action credited with directly creating a try under the source's statistical definition.
terms.research_use: Assess playmaking contribution and compare creators.

terms.plain_language: A team's performance separated by venue or home-and-away context.
terms.research_use: Research whether performance differs materially by location and whether the sample is sufficient.

terms.plain_language: A player being removed from a previously named squad or team before the match.
terms.research_use: Track the timing, replacement player and any sourced reason without inferring an undisclosed cause.

terms.plain_language: An outside-back position commonly listed at jerseys 2 and 5 in an NRL team list.
terms.research_use: Target finishing, carries, kick returns, line breaks and defensive-edge combination evidence.
